{{Top|leg}}
'''Jolee Falls''' was a waterfall that was located on [[Mount Vorena]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]. It was named after [[Jolee]], the daughter of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorin Se'ol]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
